meta.name: Circuito de Navarra
meta.description: Circuito de Navarra, Main Track (4.30 km), Medium (2.65 km) and Short (1.32 km) layouts from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the IGN MDT05 (PNOA LIDAR, 5 m). Dry northern-Spain hills of scrub and bare ground beside Los Arcos.

imported.source: Layout and woodland (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Heights: MDT05 (c) Instituto Geografico Nacional de Espana (IGN), derived from PNOA LIDAR, CC BY 4.0 (scne.es).
